extraction.Name: Mabel Jones (Dewitt)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded April 6, 1918, but the records do not show by whom
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Charles A. Burr for $3000 on April 29, 1918; conveyed by deed to Edward Hagel for $1400 subject to the foregoing mortgages on March 5, 1919
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612797 issued; East half of Northeast quarter and Northeast quarter of Southeast quarter, section 22, and Northwest quarter of Southwest quarter of section 23, township 96, north of range 72; receipt signed in February, 1918, by the allottee; deed to Edward Hagel executed by Mabel Dewitt, formerly Mabel Jones, and W. E. Dewitt
